scripts.build:paseo:types: npm run build --workspace=@getpaseo/protocol && npm run build --workspace=@getpaseo/relay && npm run build --workspace=@getpaseo/client && npm run build --workspace=@paseo/plugin
scripts.build:paseo: npm run build:paseo:types && npm run build --workspace=@getpaseo/highlight && npm run build --workspace=@getpaseo/server && npm run build --workspace=@getpaseo/cli && npm run build:main --workspace=@getpaseo/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build:paseo && npm run build:meetless && npm run build:app
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:paseo:types && tsc -b tsconfig.build.json --pretty false && npm run typecheck --workspace=@meetless/app
scripts.pretest: npm run build:paseo:types && npm run build:meetless
scripts.test:focused: vitest run --config vitest.config.ts packages/meeting-domain packages/meeting-store packages/meeting-surface packages/meetless-client packages/meetless-plugin packages/meetless-app packages/runtime
scripts.validate:isolation: node packages/runtime/dist/source-guard.js && node packages/runtime/dist/app-boundary.js && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts packages/runtime/test/isolation.test.ts packages/runtime/test/source-guard.test.ts packages/runtime/test/app-boundary.test.ts packages/runtime/test/lifecycle.test.ts packages/runtime/test/proof-publication.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
